title: Cross-Functional Contract Copilot
subtitle: One contract. Role-specific revision guidance. Shared follow-through.
localization: English editorial summaries of a Chinese-language deployment; not an English runtime UI or live API recording.

roles.name: Commercial
roles.risk: Deliverables and charges for scope changes are not defined.
roles.action: Specify deliverables, scope boundaries, and change-order pricing.

roles.name: Operations
roles.risk: Acceptance lacks objective criteria and a feedback deadline.
roles.action: Define acceptance criteria, response windows, and client responsibilities.

roles.name: Legal
roles.risk: The agreement does not define a liability cap or the scope of compensation.
roles.action: Add a liability cap, IP ownership terms, and termination settlement provisions.

roles.name: Finance
roles.risk: Payment is due 180 days after acceptance; late-payment protection is missing.
roles.action: Negotiate staged payments and add late-payment protections.

limitations: Commercial and Operations share a checklist
Recommendations do not rewrite contract text
Any configured owner can update a department status
Completion deletes the associated role task; reopening recreates it on the next review
